stories.title: Restoring the bison population may be possible, ‘groundbreaking’ study finds
stories.summary: A University of Saskatchewan-led paper researched the genetics of modern bison and compared it to the DNA structure of ancient bison.

stories.title: Carney in Saskatchewan to campaign for long-shot byelection win
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney is in Yorkton to campaign for the upcoming federal byelection in Yorkton—Melville.

stories.title: ‘Henry didn’t have to die,’ grieving Regina parents say after landlords charged
stories.summary: "The wheels of justice take a long time," the family of a Regina boy who died of carbon monoxide poisoning said after their apartment building's owners were charged with breaches.

stories.title: Saskatchewan’s deficit forecasted to shrink to $784M, expenses and revenues up
stories.summary: The Saskatchewan government says its finances are improving but it's still forecasting a deficit deep in the red, with the 2026 deficit projected to be more than $780 million.

stories.title: Impaired drivers may face immediate roadside consequences in Saskatchewan
stories.summary: Saskatchewan's government introduced legislation that will allow administrative roadside punishments for impaired drivers, including immediate license suspensions and fines.

stories.title: Full Regina Transit service will resume Tuesday afternoon, city says
stories.summary: Regina Transit service will resume Tuesday afternoon after drivers were locked out by the city Monday morning, and a tentative agreement was reached that night.

stories.title: Saskatchewan police watchdog investigating death of 24-year-old man during RCMP response
stories.summary: The investigation will examine the conduct of police and the circumstances surrounding the man's death.

stories.title: Station 20 West appeals Saskatoon order to dismantle encampment
stories.summary: Station 20 West has appealed the City of Saskatoon's order to clean up an encampment on its property by the end of this month, according to its director.

stories.title: Tentative deal reached with Regina transit workers after one-day lockout
stories.summary: A news release from the city says transit service will not be restored in time for the Tuesday morning commute, but is expected to be up and running by Tuesday afternoon.

stories.title: Child killed in crash involving SUV, semi-truck on Regina Bypass
stories.summary: RCMP in Saskatchewan say a young child has died after a two-vehicle collision involving an SUV and a semi-truck.
